text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and Stock D after gains, then bought them back at higher prices; I should base trades on their outlook and my plan, not on locking in a gain or chasing a price.","My average cost is not a reason to hold a losing position or sell a winning one. I should judge each stock by its future prospects and its contribution to my overall portfolio.","I rarely trade, which helps me avoid reacting to monthly swings, but I should review my allocation periodically and rebalance when it no longer fits my risk plan."]}
